newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain's Alba expects record production in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's Alba expects record production in 1996.

text.p: Aluminum Bahrain BSC (Alba), the biggest aluminum producer in the Middle East, expects 1996 production to hit a record high, its chairman said on Wednesday.

Sheikh Isa bin Ali al-Khalifa, who is also oil and industry minister, told a regular meeting of Alba's board of directors that "actual production for this year will for the first time exceed its production capacity of 460,000 tonnes a year".
"We are heading towards a record production this year," Bahrain's official Gulf News Agency quoted him as saying.
Sheikh Isa gave no further details.
Alba is 77 percent owned by the Bahraini government and 20 percent by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. German group Breton Investments holds the rest.
